title: Berlin U-Bahn Lines - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Two sizes:** the **U1, U2, U3 and U4** run narrow **Kleinprofil** trains, the **U5, U6, U7, U8 and U9** run wide **Grossprofil** trains.
**The difference:** narrow cars are about **2.30 to 2.40 m** wide, wide cars about **2.65 m**, on the same **1435 mm** track.
**Why:** the first line of **1902** was built narrow. From the **U6 in 1923** every new line was built wide.
**No swapping:** narrow trains take power from the **top** of the third rail, wide trains from **underneath**, so the trains cannot change networks.
**The U5 boards:** some U5 cars are narrow-based **IK** trains with boards along the lower body to close the gap to the platform.
**New trains:** **JK** on the U2 since **8 September 2025**, **J** on the U5 since **18 May 2026** and on the U9 since October 2026.
**My move:** on a narrow line at rush hour, walk to the ends of the platform before the train comes.
